text:
alex: heads-up: noticed the new telemetry tag `dim_hint` landed in prod and Console's per-request estimator shows wild unit-costs for mixed-dim embeds. example: 1x512 + 1x3072 shows as 3584 units => console double-counting. Anyone else?
mira: yep saw it on sandbox. I think the preflight path uses bytes for one codepath and dims for another. backend change to emit dim_hint broke the heuristic.
sam: can repro, attaching small log: ```preflight: request_id=abc123, dims=[512,3072], estimated_units=3584, splitter_plan=[512,3072]```
ops-bot: ingress-monitor detected 24% increase in preflight failures for embed route between 10:20-10:42 UTC
jordan: Is console expectation to show 'charge units' or 'routing units'? UX had design to show both but we never implemented. Which should we show?
alex: we display 'estimated units' which customers interpret as billing. Ideally match billing math. Currently preflight does split into 2 requests but console sum != billing because billing uses dimensional rounding.
mira: root cause: dim_hint present causes preflight to choose 'dim-first' splitter which reports units as sum of dims, but billing applies chunking with a 1024 cap per shard and rounds up to next 256. So 3072 rounds to 3072 but when split into three 1024 it's same. Hmm :thinking: issue is console double counts prefix cache savings incorrectly.
sam: i think simplest short-term fix is: Console should read `billing_estimate` field emitted by router when available. Backend: we can add billing_estimate to preflight TTL in next rollout. Patch candidate: router emits billing_estimate along with split_plan.
jordan: Agree. Also we need a migration plan for historical panels. For rollout UX: show both 'router_estimate' and 'billing_estimate' with tooltip 'billing_estimate used for billing; router_estimate used for routing decisions'
alex: ops: how risky to add billing_estimate? router change minimal — one extra field. But need to ensure no perf regression on hot path.
ops-bot: deploy-bot scheduled canary 5% at 11:30 UTC. Will monitor preflight latency and error rate
mira: I'll send a small PR to runtime: add proto field `BillingEstimate` int64 and populate using same calc as billing service. Sam can add Console reading fallback to router_emitted field.
sam: will do. Quick patch snippet: ```if preflight.has_billing_estimate { ui.estimate = preflight.billing_estimate } else { ui.estimate = preflight.router_estimate }```
jordan: Add console telemetry event `console.estimate_source` with values `router|billing|fallback` so we can see adoption.
alex: action items: mira PR to router, sam PR to console, jordan telemetry, ops run 5% canary then 25% then full. Target to revert if >3% increase in preflight latency or any invoice mismatch alerts. I'll log runbook.
ops-bot: canary started at 1719643400, 5% traffic
mira: PR: r/router#482 add BillingEstimate proto, simple function to reuse billing library. link: https://github.com/redwood/r/router/pull/482
sam: PR: web/console#1298 add fallback read and tooltip. link: https://github.com/redwood/web/console/pull/1298
jordan: I'll add dashboard panel: `console_estimate_diff` to show histogram of delta between UI and billing in cents.
alex: :thumbsup: thanks all. schedule follow-up 30m after canary.
mira: on it, will post status in this thread.
sam: thanks, will watch the canary metrics and post any regressions.
ops-bot: canary 5% metrics: preflight latency +0.4%, errors +0.1% (within thresholds)
alex: closing for now, reopen if we see invoice alerts or customer tickets.
